scope: Three equal-depth desk dossiers with candidate-specific access gates; no interior/private-space route eligibility is implied.

contradictions: The municipality lists plaza, plazoleta and parish as open, but this does not establish interior-photography conditions or a recurring worship/event schedule.
2026 ceremonies prove episodic church-to-plaza movement, not ordinary daily density.
composition_questions: Can a procession, worship exit or ordinary crossing make the church–plazoleta–civic-plaza sequence legible as one spatial system rather than two landmarks?
Which palm, lamp, fountain, parked vehicle or overlapping figure would break the origin–path–destination relation?
Does moving onto the diagonal between parish threshold and plaza center reveal the sequence better than widening from 50 mm to 35 mm?

source_truth.answer: Municipal tourism records distinguish the open Plaza de los Libertadores, Plazoleta Santa María Magdalena and parish within Pueblo Libre's historic route.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The church threshold, adjoining plazoleta and larger civic plaza form a sequence for worship, procession, civic assembly and neighborhood encounter.

current_life.answer: Municipal 2026 evidence confirms cultural events, family gathering and procession between the parish and plaza; ordinary cadence remains a field observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, exit, process, cross, wait, gather and watch are credible. The strongest relation is movement beginning at the parish threshold and resolving in the civic plaza.

architectural_causality.answer: Aligned thresholds, open paving, fountain/landscape edges and the church frontage create an origin, passage and receiving field for collective movement.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Church-front postcard, empty plaza panorama and ornate interior dominate. The underused frame is the diagonal church-to-plaza route activated by one readable transition.

light_material_geometry.answer: Late side light or balanced blue hour can separate white façade, dark threshold, paving and figures; picturesque night lighting alone is insufficient.

position_then_optics.answer: Test plaza-center diagonal toward the parish, side of the church threshold and low behind a plaza edge. Start 50 mm for origin/action/destination; 35 mm only for the full sequence and 85 mm from distance for layered exit/crossing.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify same-day worship/events, remain outside ritual paths, avoid identifiable children, do not photograph worship closely without consent and cap ordinary observation at 25 minutes.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when the built sequence visibly turns private devotion into public civic movement. A standalone façade, fountain or crowd fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Plaza-center diagonal aligning church threshold, plazoleta and civic field
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Avoid clipped towers, palms over façade and parked vehicles

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adult exits or processes as others wait across the plaza
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate threshold figure from waiting group and lamps
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Respect worship; no close identifiable minors

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Low behind plaza edge looking obliquely across—not frontally at—the church
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Pedestrian crosses between fountain edge and dark threshold

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Far side angle across paving toward façade relief
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Long shadow or figure crosses paving seam
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain threshold and plaza material bands

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Oblique plaza edge combining parish exit, processional line and civic gathering point
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Exit, crossing and reception occur in three layers
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Caption is needed to connect church and plaza

contradictions: Current academic work treats Chabuca Granda as a living housing precedent but does not verify which of the original fourteen shops remain active.
Public sources do not establish unrestricted access to internal common areas or resident consent for deliberate photography.
composition_questions: Can one ordinary domestic or commercial gesture show how the reinterpretation of patio, quinta and street still mediates collective life?
Which parked vehicle, gate, laundry overlap or distant monument would erase the transition from public street to shared threshold?
Does stepping to the block corner or shared-entry axis reveal contextual continuity better than compressing Alameda and housing with 85 mm?

source_truth.answer: The 1984 Rímac project contains 48 dwellings and 14 shops and was designed by José García Bryce as housing/commercial fabric facing the Alameda de los Descalzos.

original_spatial_contract.answer: It densified house, patio and quinta types, completed the historic block edge and used transitional common spaces to connect city, commerce and dwelling.

current_life.answer: Current scholarship continues to treat it as inhabited collective housing whose common spaces support belonging; exact shop activity, maintenance and access require direct verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, return, sell, buy, greet, watch and tend are credible. The decisive verb is a resident or customer crossing the layered threshold between Alameda-facing edge and shared housing space.

architectural_causality.answer: Completed block frontage, shop thresholds, elevated/common passages and courtyard-like transitions convert a historic street edge into graduated collective access.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Formal frontal documentation and Alameda context views dominate. The underrepresented scene is a present domestic/commercial crossing that reveals the typological transition without requiring a plan.

light_material_geometry.answer: Lateral light can distinguish recesses, galleries and block depth; garúa can emphasize lived surface and threshold hierarchy without romanticizing deterioration.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public block corner, shop/shared-entry axis and lawful Alameda-side distance. Start 50 mm for threshold/action, 35 mm for block-to-Alameda relation and 85 mm only when distance preserves the complete contextual layer.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Remain on public streets unless invited, avoid windows and identifiable children, ask before sustained photography near homes/shops, observe 20 minutes and leave if residents object.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when a present act makes the old typological strategy legible as lived urban continuity. A contextual façade portrait or distant monument stack fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public block corner showing completed frontage, recessed entry and Alameda edge
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Control cars, wires and clipped corner

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Resident returns or customer crosses while another person occupies the edge
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate action from gate and parked vehicles

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Oblique public edge looking from recess toward Alameda—not at a frontal elevation
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Figure moves from deep threshold into historic street field
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No centered monument or full façade

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Distant public angle across recessed gallery and masonry planes
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Resident shadow or laundry movement crosses one recess
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.kill_trigger: Reads as texture or deterioration study

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public corner layering Alameda edge, commercial/shared threshold and dwelling circulation
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Buying/returning and greeting occur across two threshold depths
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Do not let monument or traffic dominate
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Caption is needed to explain typological continuity
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.fallback: One returning resident plus active threshold

contradictions: CAMMP records current dwelling use and good condition but its evaluation date is not a same-day access guarantee.
The October 2025 registered event was exceptional; it cannot be converted into ordinary public access or a recurring activity window.
composition_questions: Can the three-edge site and portico make domestic privacy and occasional public learning legible without exposing residents?
Which wall, vegetation, vehicle or unauthorized interior glimpse would destroy the portico–threshold–patio sequence?
Does moving between the Eguiguren frontage, boulevard edge and Roosevelt-park rear reveal the house's spatial contract better than changing focal length?

source_truth.answer: Casa García Bryce/Casa Eguiguren is a 1951–1952 private dwelling at Eguiguren 221, designed on a corner site with three public edges.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A generous setback and portico lead to vestibule, living/dining and a gallery around the patio, while separate study/service circulation addresses the boulevard and park edges.

current_life.answer: It remains a dwelling in good recorded condition and exceptionally hosted a registered guided cultural event in 2025; no routine public access is established.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, enter, guide, observe, converse and remember are evidenced during authorized occupation. Without access, meaningful absence must rely only on public-edge traces and spatial order.

architectural_causality.answer: Setback, two-column portico, emphasized door, vestibule, gallery and patio create a controlled sequence from public edge to domestic center while separate circulation protects privacy.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Canonical façade, archival/current comparison and plan views dominate. The underused lawful relation compares how three public edges announce different degrees of domestic access.

light_material_geometry.answer: Natural light reinforces the portico and interior sequence; white render, painted brick, stone base and projecting volume can reveal depth without turning private life into evidence.

position_then_optics.answer: Test only public Eguiguren frontage, boulevard side and Roosevelt-park rear unless explicitly invited. Start 50 mm for portico/edge relation, 35 mm for lawful three-edge context and 85 mm for a distant material/threshold layer.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: No interior pursuit without explicit invitation. From public space avoid windows, occupants and prolonged surveillance; if no authorized event exists, cap the survey at ten minutes and use structure-only proofs.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only if a lawful public-edge image makes the graduated domestic threshold legible, or an authorized event shows learning shaped by that sequence. A catalogue façade fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public Eguiguren sidewalk diagonal toward setback and two-column portico
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: No event; setback, portico and door must sequence clearly
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude windows, vehicles and clipped projecting volume

B_HABITAR.position: Only during authorized event, assigned edge facing portico and gallery
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Registered visitor enters while guide/observer occupies deeper plane
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate figures from columns and door
B_HABITAR.kill_trigger: Event appears staged or architecture is incidental
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Explicit invitation and participant consent mandatory

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public boulevard edge showing secondary frontage resolving toward Roosevelt park
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: No person required; different public edge changes access reading
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No private window detail or centered façade
C_ANTI_POSTAL.kill_trigger: Requires plan to understand three-edge thesis

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Distant public angle across portico, stone base and projecting upper volume
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Raking light separates three façade planes

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Authorized portico edge connecting arrival, gallery and patio glimpse without private rooms
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Visitor arrival and guided observation align across threshold layers
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Exclude private rooms and overlapping participants
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: No explicit authorization or caption must rescue domestic/public tension
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Event-only; consent and assigned position required
